bekventures-uipath:ashbyhq:bd2f849d-7704.title: Director, Product Management, Governance (Identity & Auth)
bekventures-uipath:ashbyhq:bd2f849d-7704.description: LIFE AT UIPATH The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. YOUR MISSION We're seeking a Director, Product Management to join our Governance team. You'll drive product direction across human and agent identity, delegated and scoped authorization, credential brokering, audit and attribution for non-human actors (agents), and the emerging patterns the industry is still inventing including agent-to-agent auth, MCP auth, OAuth flows for autonomous callers, just-in-time elevation, sandboxing, policy-as-code for tool access and more. This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You will not be running status meetings. You will be deep in the product: testing, prototyping with coding agents, talking to customers and FDEs, and turning what you learn into crisp direction for the engineers building it. Influence, not headcount, will your default leverage. Your north star will be enterprise trust translating into adoption: governance strict enough for the most regulated customers, and frictionless enough that builders don't route around it. WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH - Own the multi-year vision for identity, auth, and access governance across UiPath's agentic platform. - Evolve how identity (for agents, robots and humans) works at UiPath (provisioning, scoping, delegation, attestation, rotation, revocation) and set the patterns the rest of the platform builds on. - Drive the auth model for tool-calling and MCP: scoped consent, least-privilege execution, and audit trails that hold up in front of a compliance team. - Partner with the largest and most regulated customers (financial services, healthcare, public sector) on production deployments. Go deep enough to know which specific control failed and what would fix it. - Use the platform as a builder. Self-host, stand up agents, wire up auth flows, use coding agents aggressively to prototype and ship reference implementations. If you need a working example to make a point, build one. - Translate emerging standards (delegated OAuth for agents, verifiable credentials, MCP auth, policy engines like OPA/Cedar) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product. - Define the metrics that matter (e.g. time-to-grant, audit coverage, policy violations caught, developer friction) and prioritize ruthlessly. - Represent UiPath's governance story externally with customers, partners, and industry forums. Build the credibility that makes CISOs say yes. WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM - 10+ years in technical PM or eng roles with specific emphasis on security engineering, identity/IAM platform work, or technical GTM. Proven track record of shipping infrastructure enterprises trust. - Deep fluency in identity and auth: OAuth 2.x/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, JWT, mTLS, secrets management, RBAC/ABAC, policy engines, audit and SIEM integration. You can read an auth flow and immediately see what's wrong with it. - Working understanding of agentic AI (tool-calling, MCP, RAG, agent design patterns) and a clear view on how identity must evolve to support autonomous actors. - Builder posture, AI-native. You write code (or prompt agents to) to test ideas and ship prototypes. You treat coding agents as leverage. You do not simply write specs or decks and wait. - First-principles thinker, comfortable in ambiguity. Can produce a defensible direction in days, not quarters. - Sharp communicator: a position doc that inspires bold decisions, a technical explanation a CISO trusts, a demo that closes the room. - Comfortable with regulated, on-prem, and hybrid environments. IDEAL BACKGROUND: - Shipped identity, auth, or securit

We use Braze - if you know it, brilliant. If not, we'll train you, but experience with any CRM will help you get there faster. You'll write for different lifecycle moments: onboarding, first reward, upgrade nudges, reactivation, in-product copy. You'll collaborate with the partnerships team to bring our reward partners to life across email, social, website. You'll track what's working and feed it back in. You'll support on website copy, ad creative, scripting, product messaging. Not as a favour, but because good content people make everything around them better. You'll want to be involved. What we need from you You make content. Real content, that you're proud of, that you'd show us without being asked. A portfolio or a social handle is worth more than anything else in your application. You write well. Not "good for a brief" well. Actually good. You live on social. What works on TikTok isn't what works on LinkedIn. You know this because you've tested it, not because someone told you. You're comfortable on camera.

serena-inato:ashbyhq:e5202128-8679-40ad-.description: WHO WE ARE Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we are building the world's first clinical trial platform to create greater visibility, access, and engagement across a more diverse population of doctors and their patients. Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor: we enable global pharmaceutical companies to confidently partner with community-based researchers to increase patient access to the latest medical innovations. Our AI-powered platform currently offers clinical trials from leading companies to over 5,500 sites across the globe and we are well poised for growth in 2026. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research. Inato is the recent recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025. THE ROLE As our Finance Manager - FP&A & Business Partnering, you will be at the heart of how Inato understands and steers its business. You will work closely with our VP Finance & People, a hands-on FP&A leader who will invest in your development and give you real ownership as you grow into the role. This is a company-wide position: you will contribute to financial reporting, planning, and business partnering across all functions. The scope is broad and the learning curve is steep, which is exactly the point. If you are intellectually curious and want to grow fast inside a company where finance has a real seat at the table, this role is for you. RESPONSIBILITIES Financial Reporting - Contribute to internal financial reporting, including monthly management packs and performance updates for the leadership team - Support the preparation of board-level financial materials: clear, accurate, and decision-ready - Help build and maintain reporting frameworks that give the business a reliable view of its financial health Planning & Forecasting - Contribute to the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts - Build and maintain financial models to support strategic and operational decision-making - Track performance against plan and flag risks and opportunities - Develop an understanding of our AI compute cost structure, a core driver of our unit economics, and reflect it accurately in models - Contribute to financial modeling of our revenue streams and help track business model evolution - Work with commercial and product teams to maintain revenue forecasts grounded in operational reality QUALIFICATIONS - 4-6 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, or management consulting - Solid financial modeling skills: you are comfortable building and working with structured models - Strong analytical skills and strong communication: you turn data into clear narratives, and you can explain difficult concepts in plain terms to any audience, in writing or in conversation - A high bar for accuracy: you know the devil is in the details, and you have a talent for catching errors before they matter - Hungry to learn: you ask good questions, seek feedback, and want to grow quickly - An entrepreneurial mindset: you like challenges, you are comfortable getting hands-on, and you thrive in environments where things are still being figured out - Some experience or strong appetite for business partnering: you enjoy working with people outside of finance, translating numbers into decisions, and contributing to cross-functional conversations - Background in startup, scale-up, or consulting, ideally a mix - Based in France NICE TO HAVE - Tech sector experience - Working knowledge of accounting concepts, enough to collaborate effectively with an accounting team - Familiarity with AI tools and comfort integrating them into day-to-day analytical work WHY
